title: Entrance signage and interior seating at a Communication Center
objects_and_counts: One tall vertical freestanding sign/pillar is visible in the left-central foreground against the glass (dark/black panel with white text and icons).
Three white or light-coloured chairs are visible in the right foreground inside the building; all three are mostly unobscured and show backs and legs.
One glass façade or large glass window/door is visible immediately to the right of the vertical sign, carrying circular decal elements and text.
One brochure or literature rack (appears to be a multi-tier metal stand with printed material) is visible behind the chairs, leaning slightly and partially reflected in the glass.
One chain-link fence is visible outside on the left side of the image, with attached light-coloured fabric or mesh and green panels at its base.
One set of circular decal elements arranged in rows on the glass (forming the words 'COMMUNICATION' and 'CENTER') is visible; these are printed on the glass, not freestanding objects.
One small circular information icon (a lowercase 'i' inside a circle) is visible near the top of the vertical sign.
Additional interior objects such as shelving or stacked items are visible beyond the glass but are partially obscured and not counted individually.
visible_text: コミュニケーションセンター

spatial_relations: The tall vertical sign/pillar stands immediately in front of the glass façade; it occupies the left-central foreground and partially occludes what is behind it.
To the right of the vertical sign is the glass wall/entrance with circular decal elements spelling 'COMMUNICATION' and 'CENTER' across its surface.
The three light-coloured chairs are placed inside the building directly in front of the glass, aligned left-to-right in the right foreground of the image.
The brochure/literature rack is located behind and slightly to the left of the chairs, nearer the glass and partially reflected in that glass.
Outside the building to the far left of the image is a chain-link fence with attached fabric/mesh and green panels at the bottom showing tree silhouettes.
colours_and_materials: The vertical sign/pillar appears to be a dark or black matte panel with white printed text and icons.
The chairs are white or light-coloured fabric or plastic with light-coloured legs (exact material uncertain).
The façade is glass and reflective, showing interior reflections and circular white decal elements.
The chain-link fence is metallic (grey), with light-coloured fabric/mesh attached and green lower panels bearing darker tree silhouettes.
uncertainties: Some smaller printed posters and text behind the glass and on the bookshelf/rack are partially visible but their text is unreadable at this resolution; those items are not transcribed.

The word 'UTokyo' is transcribed as seen on the sign; stylisation or precise capitalization beyond visible characters is preserved but could be part of a logo.
There may be additional chairs or objects out of frame or cropped; counts given (three chairs, one rack, one sign) are limited to clearly visible, individually distinguishable items in this image.
